https://x.com/helenamy/status/2091910883572101257 - Really happy to get this update from OpenAI today. GPT 5.6 Sol API pricing has officially been reduced, which is genuinely great news if you use frontier models for heavy reasoning, coding, agents, research, or long running experimental systems. New GPT 5.6 Sol pricing per 1 million tokens: Input: $4.00 Cached input: $0.40 Output: $20.00 For comparison, Sol previously cost $5 per 1M input tokens and $30 per 1M output tokens. So the input cost is down by 20%, while output is now about 33% cheaper. Cached input at $0.40 is especially useful for systems that repeatedly reuse large amounts of context, instructions, memory, or stable prompt material. And the output reduction matters a lot for agentic workloads, because reasoning loops, planning, tool use, reflection, coding, and multi step architectures can generate a LOT of tokens very quickly. Same Sol intelligence. More room to actually build with it. As someone constantly experimenting with AI systems, this is the kind of announcement I am very happy to receive. 😌🔥 #OpenAI #GPT56 #GPT56Sol #Codex #AI #ArtificialIntelligence #LLM #MachineLearning #AIAgents #AIResearch #API (@helenamy, 2026-08-24)
